## Soft Metadata

> [!WARNING]
> **Tier 2 (community estimate)** — Soft Metadata below adapted from publisher-disclosed practices (Elsevier author guide) and community-aggregator evidence (manusights.com submission and desk-reject guides) gathered 2026-05. Submission practitioners are invited to upgrade individual claims to Tier 1 via `/ja-validate`. See [SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md](../../../../../SEED_DATA_QUALITY.md) for the Skeleton → Tier 2 → Tier 1 lifecycle.

> **The core value of this entry.** OpenAlex cannot fill any of these — they require lived experience and community knowledge. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for guidance.

### Epistemological & Political Leanings

| Dimension | Assessment |
|-----------|------------|
| **Cross-cultural friendliness** | Medium-High — international clinical-review authorship |
| **Non-Western epistemology openness** | Medium |
| **Diversity topic receptiveness** | High — diversity in clinical populations, intervention adaptation reviews published |
| **Dominant theoretical tradition** | Clinical psychology meta-analysis / systematic review — child/adolescent (679 articles), anxiety/depression (484), mental health (326), psychotherapy techniques (258), child abuse/trauma (202), PTSD (179) per OpenAlex |

### Framing Requirements

- **Mandatory framing?** Yes (strong)
- **If yes, what kind?** Manuscripts must demonstrate **critical synthesis** rather than literature compilation. PRISMA reporting required for systematic reviews. Initial editorial assessment → minimum 2 reviewers.
- **Consequences of ignoring it**: Reviews lacking critical synthesis (vs literature compilation) get desk-rejected (community evidence: manusights desk-reject guide 2026-05). Editorial-fit issues add 1–2 weeks to timeline.

| Theoretical / Conceptual | 4 | Critical conceptual reviews accepted |
| Mixed methods | 1 | Qualitative meta-synthesis acceptable |
| Meta-analysis | 5 | Core method; PRISMA expected |

| Aspect | Detail |

| **Writing style notes** | Elsevier clinical-review format; PRISMA-aligned reporting; critical-synthesis vocabulary; structured systematic review presentation |

### Reviewer Pool Characteristics

Reviewers drawn primarily from the clinical psychology meta-analysis / systematic review community — senior faculty with synthesis expertise. Single-anonymized review per Elsevier default. Minimum 2 reviewers per submission. Common reviewer demands: "Critical synthesis vs literature compilation?", "PRISMA compliance?", "Methodological quality assessment of included studies?".

| Aspect | Detail | Evidence |
|--------|--------|----------|
| **Dominant tradition** | Clinical psychology meta-analysis + systematic review | https://www.elsevier.com/journals/clinical-psychology-review/02727358/guide-for-authors |
| **Reviewer competence variance** | Medium |
| **Quantitative mindset bias on qualitative work?** | N/A — synthesis venue |
| **Discourse community signals (editorial board)** | International clinical-psychology synthesis researchers |

### AI-Research Notes (supplementary AI research, 2026-07-13)

> Added as a **supplementary, independent research pass** — it does NOT overwrite or supersede the Tier assessment above. Treat conflicts as a signal to re-verify, not as an automatic correction. Overall `signal_quality` for this pass: **2/5**.

**AI-research finding (policy):** 此為 Elsevier 出版社統一政策（非期刊專屬頁）：作者可用生成式 AI 輔助改善語言/可讀性，須有人類監督並審閱結果，AI 不得列為作者/共同作者。審稿人與編輯目前禁止在同行評審與稿件評估過程使用生成式 AI 工具（如 ChatGPT），以保護作者權利與研究機密性；Elsevier 表示正評估合規工具，未來可能修訂。未找到 Clinical Psychology Review 期刊專屬（與出版社政策不同的）AI 政策頁面，判斷為沿用 Elsevier 通用政策。

**AI-research finding (positioning — what the journal accepts now):** 期刊僅接受「回顧型」稿件（review-format only），聚焦臨床心理疾患、介入、評估或治療結果；不接受原創實證研究、個案報告、評論文章，或無臨床應用的健康心理學/正向心理學/基礎研究稿件。要求在文章開頭即明確列出回顧問題、臨床意義與系統化方法。

**AI-research finding (experiential):** LetPub 顯示 50 位使用者評分 8.8/10，但『網友分享經驗』的審稿速度與接受率欄位為空白，無具體文字內容可摘錄。

## Strategic Notes

### Hard Blockers

- Literature compilation without critical synthesis (community evidence: manusights desk-reject guide 2026-05)
- Failure to follow PRISMA reporting for systematic reviews
- Original empirical research (consider clinical empirical venues)
- AI-generated images per Elsevier policy
- Failure to disclose AI use

### Soft Tax

Low for systematic-review tradition authors comfortable with PRISMA. Moderate for authors transitioning from empirical work — must master critical-synthesis register. 24-month AAM embargo on Elsevier subscription path is a visibility cost.

### Best Suited For

- Systematic reviews and meta-analyses in clinical psychology
- Critical conceptual reviews of clinical-psychology debates
- Treatment outcome literature syntheses
- Child trauma, anxiety, depression, PTSD synthesis work
- Psychotherapy technique meta-analyses
- Personality disorder mechanism synthesis

### Not Recommended For

- Original empirical research (consider JCCP, J Psychopathology and Clinical Science)
- Pure qualitative work
- Literature compilations without critical synthesis
- Authors needing rapid OA visibility (24-month AAM embargo)
- Pure autoethnography

### Rejection Fallback Chain

| Rank | Journal | Why this fallback works |
|------|---------|------------------------|
| 1 | [Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology](./journal-of-consulting-and-clinical-psychology.md) | If recast as treatment-outcome empirical work; APA family |
| 2 | [Journal of Psychopathology and Clinical Science](./journal-of-psychopathology-and-clinical-science.md) | If mechanism-focused synthesis; APA family |
| 3 | [Annual Review of Psychology](./annual-review-of-psychology.md) | Not applicable for direct submission (invitation-only); but informationally adjacent for synthesis tradition |

**Reverse direction** *(optional)*: If your paper was rejected from a top clinical-empirical venue as "too synthesis-oriented," Clinical Psychology Review is often a better fit because: it specializes in systematic reviews and meta-analyses; PRISMA-strict editorial culture; and Elsevier reach provides high-prestige outlet for synthesis work.
